diagnosis: The optimization loop is stuck because the skill has saturated its evaluation criteria. The current score of 36/36 indicates the skill perfectly meets all existing test scenarios. The recent mutations are all valid, proactive improvements that add clarity and handle edge cases (promotion readiness, sprint vs. status, escalation formatting). However, because the test harness lacks scenarios that specifically target these nuanced conditions, these improvements are invisible to the scoring system. The skill is getting better, but the ruler used to measure it is no longer precise enough to detect the improvement. The problem is not the skill's quality but the evaluation's lack of complexity.
